text: Casein powder and water are pushed through an extruder and spun through a jet, then cut or wound. This is melt-style spinning of a plasticised protein, unlike the wet spinning of Lanital.

steps.name: make pliable
steps.note: The casein powder is softened with water; the patent also names glycerol.

steps.name: push through
steps.note: The mix is forced through a shaped opening by an extruder, under mechanical stress.

steps.name: spin
steps.note: The mix is sent out through a jet, a nozzle with small holes.
The fibre is cut into short lengths, or kept as one long filament.
